items.term: will for decisions made now (I'll get it)
items.es: will: decisiones que tomas en el momento

example.en: It's cold in here. — I'll close the window.
example.es: Hace frío aquí. — Cierro la ventana.

items.term: going to for plans already decided (I'm going to study medicine)
items.es: going to: planes e intenciones que ya decidiste

example.en: I'm going to buy a car. I've saved enough money.
example.es: Voy a comprar un auto. Ya ahorré suficiente dinero.

items.term: present continuous for fixed arrangements (I'm meeting Ana at six)
items.es: presente continuo: citas y planes con día y hora

example.en: I can't see you tonight. I'm having dinner with my parents.
example.es: No puedo verte esta noche. Voy a cenar con mis papás.

items.term: present simple for timetables (The train leaves at 7:30)
items.es: presente simple: horarios fijos (trenes, vuelos, clases)

example.en: Hurry up! The movie starts at eight.
example.es: ¡Apúrate! La película empieza a las ocho.

items.term: will for promises and offers (I'll call you)

example.en: I'll send you the photos tonight.
example.es: Esta noche te mando las fotos.

items.term: I think… will (I think she'll win)
items.es: creo que + will: predicciones y opiniones sobre el futuro

example.en: I think it'll be a great party.
example.es: Creo que va a ser una gran fiesta.

passages.title: Weekend plans
passages.text: Sofia has a busy weekend. On Saturday morning she's playing tennis with her sister; they booked the court last week. Her bus to the coast leaves at 2:15, and she's going to spend the night at a friend's house there. She hasn't packed yet, but she says she'll do it tonight. "I think it'll rain on Sunday," she says, "so I'm going to take an umbrella."
